name: Trigify
description: Social listening + engagement intelligence — monitor profiles, companies, posts and topics across LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Substack, Bluesky, GitHub, Hacker News, Daily.dev, Podcasts and News.

methods.label: Enrich LinkedIn Profile
methods.description: Enrich a LinkedIn profile URL into name, title, company, summary, follower count, location, industry, and full work experience. Returns { data: { prospect, experience[] } }.

methods.label: Get Profile Posts
methods.description: List recent LinkedIn posts from a profile, with text, reactions, comments count, and media. Paginated.

after.description: ISO date — only posts after this

methods.label: Bulk Track Profiles (Engagement Monitor)
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Upload up to 100 LinkedIn profile URLs for engagement monitoring. Optionally attach a webhook per profile. Free upload; downstream collection costs 5 credits per new engagement result.

methods.label: Get Profile Engagement Results
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Paginated engagement results for a tracked LinkedIn profile, deduplicated by prospect across all their posts. Free.

methods.label: Get Profile Post Engagement Results
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Engagement results for a SPECIFIC tracked post of a monitored profile. Deduplicated per prospect within that post.

methods.label: Stop Tracking Profile
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Archive a tracked LinkedIn profile and remove its webhook. Free.

methods.label: Enrich LinkedIn Company
methods.description: Enrich a LinkedIn company URL into name, domain, industry, size, location, employees count, revenue, funding, technologies, growth rate.

methods.label: Get Company Posts
methods.description: List recent posts from a LinkedIn company page with reactions, comments count and media.

methods.label: Get Company Post Comments
methods.description: Get comments on a LinkedIn company post (by URN), paginated. Returns { comments[], total, totalPage, currentPage }.

methods.label: Get Post Engagements
methods.description: Get the list of users who engaged (liked, etc.) with a LinkedIn post URL. Paginated.

methods.label: Get Post Comments
methods.description: Get comments on a LinkedIn post by URN. Paginated. Use postCommentReplies to fetch replies of a specific comment.

methods.label: Get Post Comment Replies
methods.description: Get replies to a specific LinkedIn comment. Pass postUrn + commentUrn (returned by postComments). previousCursor paginates further pages.

methods.label: Get Post by URL
methods.description: Resolve a LinkedIn post URL into its full detail: text, URN, posted date, reaction counts, author, company.

methods.label: Social Mapping (Engagement Graph)
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Query Trigify's social engagement graph by keyword, firmographic and profile filters. Find prospects who engaged with specific topics. engaged_with_days = lookback (1-30).

includes.description: Fields to return: first_name, last_name, linkedin_url, avatar, company, job_title, post.text, etc.

methods.label: Discover Creators
methods.description: Find LinkedIn creators who POST about specific topics (vs. engage). Filter by job titles, firmographics, follower count, location. Returns prospect data + posting cadence + avg engagement.

methods.label: List Searches
methods.description: List all Social Listening searches for the authenticated org. Filter by status. Free.

methods.label: Get Search
methods.description: Get details of one Social Listening search by ID. Free.

methods.label: Update Search
methods.description: Update a Social Listening search's name, status (active/paused), or filters. Free.

methods.label: Delete Search
methods.description: Permanently delete a Social Listening search. Free.

methods.label: Get Search Results
methods.description: Fetch results from a saved Social Listening search. Filter by date, job title, company, industry, country, seniority. Free.

methods.label: Search Podcasts
methods.description: Search for podcasts by name. Use the returned id as podcast_id when creating a podcast-episodes monitor. Free.

methods.label: Create Twitter/X Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor X/Twitter posts by keywords. Supports advanced operators: from_users, to_user, list_id, verified_only, has_media, exclude_retweets, place_country. Costs 1 credit.

time_frame.description: past-24h | past-week | past-month | past-6-months | past-year | all-time

frequency.description: hourly | every-12h | daily | weekly | monthly | quarterly

methods.label: Create LinkedIn Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor LinkedIn posts by keywords. Filter by job_titles (max 6), content_type, member/org mentions. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Reddit Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor Reddit posts AND comments across all of Reddit by keywords. Use createSubredditPostsSearch to monitor a specific subreddit instead. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Subreddit Monitor
methods.description: Monitor a SPECIFIC subreddit for new posts (no r/ prefix). Optionally filter by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create YouTube Videos Search
methods.description: Monitor YouTube videos by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Substack Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor Substack posts by keywords and/or a specific publication. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Substack Notes Monitor
methods.description: Monitor a specific Substack author's notes by handle (@username or username). Optionally filter by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Podcast Keywords Search
methods.description: Monitor podcast episode TRANSCRIPTS for keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Hacker News Stories Search
methods.description: Monitor Hacker News stories and comments by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create News Articles Monitor
methods.description: Monitor news articles by keywords (boolean OR/AND/NOT). Optionally restrict to specific publisher domains or country. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Daily.dev Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor Daily.dev developer posts. Multiple search modes: keyword-search, tag-based-feed, source-based-feed, smart-recommendations, most-discussed, popular-by-tags. Costs 1 credit.

search_mode.description: keyword-search | smart-recommendations | tag-based-feed | source-based-feed | popular-by-tags | most-discussed

methods.label: Create TikTok Videos Search
methods.description: Monitor TikTok videos. TikTok has no boolean logic — each keyword runs as an independent search and results are merged. past-year is NOT supported. Costs 1 credit.

time_frame.description: past-24h | past-week | past-month | past-6-months | all-time (no past-year)

methods.label: Create GitHub Issues Search
methods.description: Monitor GitHub issues by keywords. Optionally scope to specific repos (owner/repo format). Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create GitHub Discussions Search
methods.description: Monitor GitHub discussions by keywords. Optionally scope to specific repos. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Bluesky Posts Search
methods.description: Monitor Bluesky posts by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor Twitter/X Profile
methods.description: Monitor new posts from a specific X/Twitter profile URL. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor LinkedIn Profile or Company
methods.description: Monitor new posts from a specific LinkedIn profile OR company page. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor YouTube Channel
methods.description: Monitor new videos from a YouTube channel URL. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor Substack Publication
methods.description: Monitor new posts from a Substack publication. Provide profile_url OR publication (name/subdomain/URL). Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor TikTok Profile
methods.description: Monitor new videos from a TikTok creator. Accepts URL (https://tiktok.com/@handle) or @handle. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor Bluesky Profile
methods.description: Monitor new posts from a Bluesky profile URL. Optionally filter by keywords. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Monitor Podcast Episodes
methods.description: Monitor new episodes from a specific podcast. Use searchPodcasts first to find the podcast_id. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Social Signals Metadata
methods.description: Get supported Social Signals definitions, default config, statuses, and billing metadata.

methods.label: Social Signals Limits
methods.description: Get tier-derived Social Signals limits and current usage for the authenticated org.

methods.label: Social Signals Status
methods.description: Get aggregate Social Signals subscription and enrichment status.

methods.label: Create Social Signals Subscriptions
methods.description: Batch upsert LinkedIn profile or company URLs into Social Signals monitoring (max 100).

methods.label: List Social Signals Subscriptions
methods.description: List Social Signals subscriptions, optionally filtered by status.

methods.label: Bulk Stop Social Signals Subscriptions
methods.description: Stop multiple Social Signals subscriptions (max 100 IDs) without deleting historical results.

methods.label: Get Social Signals Subscription
methods.description: Get one Social Signals subscription by ID.

methods.label: Update Social Signals Subscription
methods.description: Update Social Signals signal config or pause/resume a subscription.

methods.label: Stop Social Signals Subscription
methods.description: Stop one Social Signals subscription without deleting historical results.

methods.label: Estimate Social Signals Credits
methods.description: Estimate daily Social Signals credit usage for a subscription config. Provide either target_count or target_urls.

methods.label: List Social Signals Feed
methods.description: Activity feed of Social Signals events and generated insights. Filter by signal type, severity, target, date range.

methods.label: List Social Signals Targets
methods.description: List monitored Social Signals targets with their latest signal and enrichment status.

methods.label: Get Social Signals Target Profile
methods.description: Get a monitored target's profile, enrichment status, and recent signal timeline.

methods.label: List Social Signals Target Insights
methods.description: Generated AI insights for a monitored target.

methods.label: List Social Signals Target Check Runs
methods.description: Recent Social Signals check runs (provider calls) for a target.

methods.label: List Social Signals Results
methods.description: List produced Social Signals results with filters by target, signal type, severity, subscription, date.

methods.label: Get Social Signals Result
methods.description: Get one produced Social Signals result by ID.

methods.label: Create Topic Search
methods.description: ENTERPRISE. Create a Social Topic search for LinkedIn keyword monitoring. Active topics rediscover daily at 06:00 UTC; engagements backfill at Day 1, 3, 5. Free to create; credits charged per discovered post/engagement. Auto-expires after 30 days.

content_type.description: posts | videos | photos | liveVideos | collaborativeArticles | documents

methods.label: List Topic Searches
methods.description: List all enterprise-only Social Topic searches for the org. Free.

methods.label: Get Topic Search
methods.description: Get details for a Social Topic search. Free.

methods.label: Update Topic Search
methods.description: Update topic name or status (ACTIVE/PAUSED/STOPPED). Free.

methods.label: Delete Topic Search
methods.description: Soft-delete a Social Topic search. Free.

methods.label: Get Topic Credit Summary
methods.description: Current billing-period credit allocation for a topic, split between new-post credits and engagement-backfill credits. Free.

methods.label: Get Topic Engagements (Deduplicated)
methods.description: Paginated engagers for a topic, deduplicated by prospect. Each prospect appears once with their latest engagement. Free.

methods.label: Get Topic Post Engagements
methods.description: All engagers for a specific LinkedIn post within a topic, with NO dedup. Free.

methods.label: Get Usage Summary
methods.description: Usage metrics for the authenticated org: credits consumed (with breakdown by feature), active monitors, results collected. Free.

from.description: ISO 8601, defaults to start of billing month

methods.label: Get X Post Comments
methods.description: Fetch comments/replies on an X (Twitter) post URL. Up to 1000 comments per call.

methods.label: Get X Post Engagements (Likes)
methods.description: List users who LIKED a given X post. Requires a connected X account on the org. Costs 1 credit PER engagement returned.

methods.label: Enrich X User
methods.description: Enrich an X/Twitter user by handle (without @): bio, verified, follower/following/tweet counts, location, profile image, website.

methods.label: Lookup X User by Username
methods.description: Look up an X user's user_id, name, bio, and counts. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Like X Post (Action)
methods.description: Like an X post using a connected X account. Costs 1 credit. Provide tweet_id; optionally specify which X account_id.

methods.label: Reply to X Post (Action)
methods.description: Reply to an X post. text max 280 chars. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Repost X Post (Action)
methods.description: Repost (retweet) an X post. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete X Post (Action)
methods.description: Delete an X post you own. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Create X Post (Action)
methods.description: Create a new X post. Optionally include a poll (2-4 options, 5-10080 min duration) or media_ids (max 4). Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Follow X User (Action)
methods.description: Follow an X user by their user_id. Costs 1 credit.

methods.label: Send X Direct Message (Action)
methods.description: Send a DM on X. REQUIRES X Pro tier. Costs 2 credits. text max 10000 chars.

methods.label: List Connected X Accounts
methods.description: List all X accounts connected to the authenticated organisation. Free.

methods.label: Get X Account Connect URL
methods.description: Get the URL to connect a new X account, plus the current connection status. Free.

methods.label: List Organisations
methods.description: List all organisations the authenticated user has access to (owned + member).

methods.label: Get Organisation
methods.description: Get the authenticated user's organisation including name, plan, subscription status, member count. Free.

methods.label: Get Credit Balance
methods.description: Current credit balance, subscription plan, and next reset date. Free.

methods.label: Get Credit Usage History
methods.description: Individual credit consumption records for the last N days. Free.

methods.label: Get Credit Usage Breakdown
methods.description: Credit usage aggregated by feature for the last N days. Free.

methods.label: Create Workflow Table
methods.description: Create a new Workflow Table for storing agent memory. Free.

methods.label: List Workflow Tables
methods.description: List all workflow tables for the org. Free.

methods.label: Create Workflow
methods.description: Create a new workflow from a JSON definition. Optionally link to a saved search. Free.

methods.label: List Workflows
methods.description: List workflows for the org, paginated. Free.

methods.label: List Workflow Actions
methods.description: List all available workflow action kinds with inputs/outputs. Free. Useful for building workflow JSON.

category.description: ai | enrichment | crm | messaging | social | control_flow | utility | integration | other

methods.label: List Workflow Examples
methods.description: Example workflow definitions for common patterns. Free.

methods.label: List Workflow Triggers
methods.description: Available workflow trigger kinds with inputs/outputs. Free.

methods.label: Get Workflow
methods.description: Get a single workflow by ID. Free.

methods.label: Update Workflow
methods.description: Partially update a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Delete Workflow
methods.description: Soft-delete a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Upsert Workflow Draft
methods.description: Create or update the draft for a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Get Workflow Draft
methods.description: Get the current draft for a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Delete Workflow Draft
methods.description: Remove the draft for a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Test Workflow
methods.description: Trigger a test execution of a workflow. Returns a test_run_id you can poll via getWorkflowExecution. Optionally pass overrides for the trigger data.

overrides.description: Override trigger data: author_url, text, likes, comments, post_url, date_posted, source, signal_type, severity

methods.label: List Workflow Executions
methods.description: Paginated execution logs for a workflow. Free.

methods.label: Get Workflow Execution
methods.description: Get a single workflow execution log with ordered step details (input, output, mapped_output, errors). Free.

methods.label: List Connected Integrations
methods.description: List all OAuth and API-key integrations connected to the workspace (Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, Linear, Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, Gmail, Instantly, Smartlead, HeyReach, LaGrowthMachine). Free.

methods.label: Check Integration Health
methods.description: Validates OAuth token freshness for an integration. Optional crm-fields probe for HubSpot/Attio/Salesforce. Free.

type.description: slack | hubspot | attio | salesforce | linear | notion | airtable | google_sheets | gmail

methods.label: List Slack Channels
methods.description: List channels in the connected Slack workspace, optionally filtered. Free.

methods.label: List Slack Users
methods.description: List users in the connected Slack workspace. Free.

methods.label: Get CRM Fields
methods.description: Get contacts + companies field schemas for HubSpot, Attio, or Salesforce. Free.

methods.label: Get CRM Field Options (Attio)
methods.description: Get select/multiselect options for an Attio field. Free.

methods.label: List Linear Teams
methods.description: List all Linear teams. Free.

methods.label: List Linear Users
methods.description: List Linear users, optionally filtered by team or search. Free.

methods.label: List Linear Workflow States
methods.description: Workflow states for a Linear team. Free.

methods.label: List Notion Databases
methods.description: List Notion databases, optionally filtered by title. Free.

methods.label: Get Notion Database Schema
methods.description: Properties/schema for a Notion database. Free.

methods.label: List Airtable Bases
methods.description: List all Airtable bases. Free.

methods.label: List Airtable Tables
methods.description: List tables within an Airtable base. Free.

methods.label: Get Airtable Table Fields
methods.description: Field/column definitions for an Airtable table. Free.

methods.label: List Google Sheets Documents
methods.description: List Google Sheets spreadsheets. Free.

methods.label: List Sheets in a Google Sheets Doc
methods.description: List sheets/tabs within a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Free.

methods.label: Get Google Sheets Columns
methods.description: Column headers for a Google Sheets sheet. Free.

methods.label: List Campaigns (Instantly / Smartleads / HeyReach)
methods.description: List campaigns from the connected Instantly, Smartleads, or HeyReach integration. Free.

methods.label: List LaGrowthMachine Audiences
methods.description: List LaGrowthMachine audiences. Free.
